newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay seeks one mln bbls of crude for June 20-25.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay seeks one mln bbls of crude for June 20-25.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP is seeking to buy one million barrels of crude oil for delivery June 20-25, trade sources said on Monday.
Bids will be received through April 28. ANCAP will award the tender on April 29.
The company is seeking to purchase crude with an API (American Petroleum Institute) gravity of 26-45 degrees and a sulfur content of 0.5 percent to 1.8 percent.
The crude is to be delivered to Uruguay's Jose Ignacio terminal.
Separately, ANCAP has launched an LPG tender for delivery from June through September.
The company is seeking a total volume of 25,000 cubic meters (157,250 barrels), covering 65 percent butane and 35 percent propane.
